content.subject: Fw: MLB beat writers survey for The Boston Globe

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, May 26, 2016 7:05 PM
To: Bowers, Rachel G. <rachel.bowers@globe.com>
Subject: Re: MLB beat writers survey for The Boston Globe 
 
Hello Rachel,
So sorry I didn't get back to you. Just catching up on old e-mails. Thank you for reaching out.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Bowers, Rachel G. <rachel.bowers@globe.com>
Sent: Wednesday, March 23, 2016 11:21:35 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: MLB beat writers survey for The Boston Globe 
 
Also, as an aside, this is an anonymous survey. The name and email portion is for me to keep track of who has responded.

On Wed, Mar 23, 2016 at 10:28 AM, Bowers, Rachel G. <rachel.bowers@globe.com> wrote:
Hi Anthony,

We'd like to invite you to participate in our MLB beat writer survey to preview the upcoming season. The survey consists of nine basic questions, such as which teams will advance to the World Series and bat flips: yes or no.
We would make the results of the survey available for your outlet to use online or in print. We'll distribute the results to those who participate before we post them to our website.
If you are interested in participating, you can find the survey here. Ideally, answers are submitted by Wednesday, March 30.
Please let me know if you have any trouble with it. Thanks!

-- 
Rachel G. Bowers
Sports Producer
BostonGlobe.com
@RachelGBowers

-- 
Rachel G. Bowers
